name: FlowDroid 2.15.0
body: Several larger improvements including a backwards data flow analysis and a forward alias analysis, plus many bug fixes.

name: FlowDroid 2.14
body: The new version of FlowDroid supports recent additions to the ARSC file format for Android as well as Java streams.

name: FlowDroid 2.7.1
body: This release contains important bug fixes for FlowDroid 2.7. Version 2.7 is the new release of the FlowDroid data flow solver with major improvements to the StubDroid component for handling method summaries.

name: FlowDroid 2.7
body: Version 2.7 is the new release of the FlowDroid data flow solver with major improvements to the StubDroid component for handling method summaries.

name: FlowDroid 2.6.1
body: The FlowDroid 2.6.1 release contains important bug fixes to the FlowData data flow solver.

name: FlowDroid 2.6
body: The FlowDroid 2.6 release contains all bug fixes and improvements that were introduced after the 2.5.1 release.

name: FlowDroid 2.5.1
body: The FlowDroid 2.5.1 release is the first version to coherently use Maven as a build system. We have integrated all parts of FlowDroid into a single repository. While ICCTA is already onboard since version 2.0, we now also officially integrated StubDroid into the core development tree. Furthermore, we have re-written the command-line tool from scratch.
